svg.title: 01 · P50 / WH_Signals/WH_SendSignals
svg.text: Native RLL · 5 source / 5 displayed rungs · full · Programs/WH_Signals/Routines/WH_SendSignals · bacc6e0c4028803edac7
ADDED · INIT constants: signed DINT maximum and maximum minus one. Ordered branches initialize the controller-wide software constants before any consumer.
ADDED · New startup baseline. Existing MSG carries word [3]; no array or message configuration change.
ADDED · Retain a Cycle Start edge as a counter change even when the pulse ends before the next message.
ADDED · Bounded counter wraps to 1 on this edge, without overflowing a DINT.
ADDED · Existing press-to-FDC MSG already writes words [2..3]. FDC records approximate arrival time.
SOURCE · original PLC storage / Item InOut
Blue = original. Red = fault + nonzero code; fault 0 = neutral. Yellow = state + value. GUTTER = group / qualifier; INIT is a label only.
